ns2:course.label: Latin Am Lit & Cult to 1800
ns2:course.description: Critical analysis of selected texts and periods representatives of Latin American literary and cultural production from Pre-Columbian until 1800, with special attention paid to broader literary and cultural contexts. Specific sections may emphasize critical topics such as gender, ideology, literary form, nationalisms, race, and sexuality, among others. Prerequisite: SPAN 250 or SPAN 254.
